profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer focused on Frontend, Web and AI Technologies at Microsoft
profile.summary: Sr. Software Engineer with 10 years of hands experience on frontend, web site technologies and Certified ScrumMaster since Oct 2019. Also, 8 years as Project Manager with valuable contributions by leading, managing and collaborating with stakeholders, partners, and users to integrate modern technologies. Deeply passionate for solving complex problems, web/mobile, new methodologies & programming languages.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Build responsive, user-delighting web experiences that look great across multiple devices, browsers, and surfaces.
- Maintain an unwavering focus on Quality of Service and execute with high accountability.

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description: - Design, develop and test Web and Mobile software features using Angular 2. - Collaborate with User Experience (UX) designers. - Create intuitive, performant and accessible UI to keep Net Promoter Score (NPS) high. - Promote DevOps culture, Agile methodology, automated software testing and reliability. - Write technical design documents and confluence ‘How-To’s.

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed web applications built on React ES6 / JSX.
- Worked closely with Product and UX/Design, giving input to constraints, timelines, and feasibility.
- Developed JEST tests.

Working for Vium but was acquired by Recursion in 2020: 
https://www.recursion.com/news/recursion-acquires-vium-bolstering-its-efforts-to-industrialize-drug-discovery

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented markdown text processing for Bot Framework Web Chat using React (+500 downloads/week)
- Developed Channel Inspector for user guidance about features bots. (+25 visits/week)
- Provided technical support for internal Microsoft teams, external top 5 customers and users.

positions.title: Senior QA Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead QA strategy and implementation for Bot Framework (BF) product team.
- Implemented BF SDK automatic tests using Selenium. (~250 tests)
- Developed BF Web Chat Tests using Electron, Mocha and Mock_DL. (+500 downloads/week)

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
- Developed Nescafe Dolce Gusto vending machine coffee IOS application. (~30 users/week)
- Defined application maintenance and support for +50 coffee vending machines in 3 countries.

positions.title: Senior Information Technology Manager
positions.description:
- Led 9 site supervisors in P&G Mexico, each accountable for IT service operations and delivery.
- Improved IT services operations for +2.7K employees resulting in +$45K USD savings.
- Developed Latin America mobility web site reducing 20% of company spends (~$1.7MM USD).
- Fixed e-invoice bugs to bring customer payments back for +$1.2MM USD.
- Represented P&G in GS1 Mexico Electronic Commerce leadership team.

honors.title: P&G Best-in-class Windows 7 Deployment
honors.description: Obtained the global P&G best-in-class Windows 7 deploy: getting pilot feedback and lead final self-service user implementation.

honors.title: Highest honors at ITESM CEM
honors.issuer: Issued by Tecnológico de Monterrey. Campus Estado de México · May 2008

volunteerExperiences.description:
-	Delivered mockup for the new order acquisition tool as the 1st WPD result to LATAM IT Directors. 
-	Delivered strategy to simplify usage of 1 device for sales team managers as the 2nd WPD result for LATAM Sales Vice Presidents.

- Researched agent’s behavior definition in areas of genetic algorithms, evolutive programming and reinforcement learning.
- Led 10 undergraduate, 2 masters & 1 doctorate Computer Science students.

http://spl.robocup.org/history/teams-2008/

projects.title: World Cup Scheduler
projects.description:
FIFA World Cup 2026 — Schedule & Bracket Predictor

A fast React + Vite app to view the full World Cup schedule, enter your own scores, and watch the group standings and knockout bracket fill in automatically.

URL => https://reyesrico.github.io/world-cup-scheduler/

projects.title: Stuffie Project
projects.description:
I am the Archictect and PM Leader for Stuffie. Stuffie is a social network project to store and share all product inventory of any user.

URL:    https://reyesrico.github.io/StuffieReact
